title: Khóa phạm vi hai module Chatbot và Kế toán
statusMeaning: The brief can be picked up for planning; runtime readiness and authorization are checked in a fresh session.
why: The release contains exactly two product modules: Chatbot and Accounting. Inspect the existing support-desk/customer-support, legacy multichannel-chatbot and finance-copilot/accounting definitions; select one durable identity for each rather than creating duplicate modules.
decisionQuestions: Which existing Chatbot identity is canonical: support-desk with its richer runtime gates, or the legacy multichannel-chatbot package with an explicit upgrade?
Confirm the exact Accounting MVP: which records, approvals, reports and import sources are required for acceptance?
Which Chatbot channel is the first supported live channel, and who is the authorized test recipient?
acceptance: Freeze exactly two user-visible module contracts, Chatbot and Accounting; no third module is introduced.
Choose the Chatbot identity from the existing support-desk and legacy multichannel-chatbot definitions, with a documented compatibility/migration rule.
Bind Accounting to existing finance-copilot/accounting where compatible; distinguish its generic approval widget from a usable bookkeeping flow.
For each module freeze actor, setup fields, supported inputs/actions, outcomes, failures, owner handoff and launch criteria.

Suggested Accounting MVP: capture evidence, classify inflow/expense, human approval, durable posting, reconciliation and reporting; provider payments/tax filing stay outside the current contract unless separately decided.
Supporting knowledge/retrieval is inside these two modules, never a standalone Knowledge Hub requirement.
Define the second brain ownership, knowledge sources, review/update lifecycle and permitted sharing for each of the two modules.

includes: Khóa phạm vi hai module Chatbot và Kế toán

excludes: Unrelated source, shared credentials and production deployment

doneWhen.evidence: A Nivo-bound business promise and frozen coverage matrix resolve the named questions with actual owner decisions.

goalDraft.sourceRef: user:2026-09-05 final scope: exactly two modules, one accounting and one chatbot; business flows included; Template App later

execution.liveEffects: No live effect is authorized by banking. At activation use environment declarations and the exact mission scope; real outbound messages require explicit user authorization.
execution.seeding: A dedicated owner and stranger, per-flow run namespace, deterministic IDs, exact marker/owner checks on reuse and dependency-safe cleanup. Fixture history is labelled and cannot stand for Test, Apply, payment or provider success. Create fixtures only for the selected Chatbot and Accounting modules; knowledge fixtures are supporting inputs, not a third module.
execution.failureRouting: Read the executing operator stop and current .claude/routing.json; this card defines no alternate routes.
execution.publication: If source is changed, include git.publish only in the activated scope and derive all required gates. Backend business changes also require business.reconcile where a published promise applies.
